Download series from outside sources

get_series_src.Rd

Download series from outside sources

Usage

get_series_src(
  id,
  source = c("fred", "statcan", "boc", "estat", "eia"),
  freq = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  filters = list(),
  format = c("wide", "long", "xts")
)

Arguments

id

series ids: FRED codes ("UNRATE"), StatCan vectors ("v2062810"), Bank of Canada Valet series ("FXMUSDCAD"), e-Stat table ids ("0004052037") or EIA series ids ("WTIPUUS"). Several ids are read one by one.

source

"fred", "statcan", "boc", "estat" or "eia"

freq

NULL (default) keeps the source's frequency; "month" averages daily or weekly data to months and drops the current calendar month. A month at either end of the data with only some days is still averaged, so set start to the first of a month.

start

first date to request (any form to_ymd() reads; default 1940)

filters

named list of further query parameters. e-Stat: the table's category codes, e.g. list(cdTab = "1", cdCat01 = "0001", cdArea = "00000"). EIA: route (e.g. "steo" or "aeo/2025"), frequency ("monthly", "annual") and facets such as scenario = "ref2025"; EIA returns at most 5,000 observations per series. FRED: added to the request as query parameters, e.g. list(units = "pc1"). StatCan and Bank of Canada: ignored.

format

"wide" (default), "long" or "xts", as in get_series()

Value

the series, in the chosen format, named by id

Details

Keys come from the environment or the keyring (see set_api_key()); StatCan and the Bank of Canada need none. Downloads are tried three times. StatCan answers with an empty list during its nightly maintenance; that gives an error saying so. For e-Stat, the filters must leave one value per date; monthly and annual time codes are read.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
get_series_src(c("UNRATE", "CIVPART"), "fred", start = 2020)
get_series_src("DCOILWTICO", "fred", freq = "month", start = 2024)
get_series_src("v2062810", "statcan")
get_series_src("FXMUSDCAD", "boc", start = 2017)
get_series_src(
  "0004052037", "estat",
  filters = list(cdTab = "1", cdCat01 = "0001", cdArea = "00000")
)
get_series_src(
  "WTIPUUS", "eia",
  filters = list(route = "steo", frequency = "monthly")
)
}
